data.outcome_summary: Education at a Glance 2025 (Hungary country note) provides a descriptive overview of education-system characteristics, with emphasis on tertiary education, using the latest available reference-year data. The note highlights intergenerational educational inequality (e.g., large tertiary-attainment gaps by parents’ education), labour-market associations with educational attainment (unemployment rates by attainment level), and literacy proficiency patterns from the OECD Survey of Adult Skills (PIAAC), including the share at or below Level 1 and score gaps between attainment groups. It also reports trends over time (e.g., changes in unemployment and literacy scores between PIAAC Cycle 1 and Cycle 2) and system-level indicators related to access and progression in tertiary education (entry routes, gender composition, completion and dropout patterns). Because this is not an original student-level empirical ML study, no model performance metrics, PV-handling procedure, or missing-data strategy are specified in the note; methodological details are instead directed to the Education at a Glance 2025 technical documentation.
